Response from Developer

Feb 11, 2026

I am sorry the app did not meet your expectations. It is not a traditional task manager or long term planner. It is designed for people with ADHD who struggle with focus and memory, so it emphasizes immediate tasks and short term reminders to help stay on track right now. I plan to improve the task manager mode so it can be used as a planner, but it is important for me not to break the experience for current users 🙏 The sound turns on immediately when you switch from Reminder to Task and start the timer.

### Button position issues with multiple displays

I've been using this app for a while and it's generally useful, but there's an annoying issue with button positioning when using multiple displays. Every time I restart my laptop, the button doesn't stay where I previously placed it.My typical workflow involves opening my laptop lid, entering my credentials, then closing the lid to use external monitors. The app launches automatically during system startup, but it seems that the change in active displays during this process causes the button to reset its position.
